errors.text: Identifies CoCrFeMnNi Cantor alloy rather than the targeted dual-phase FeCoNiTi alloy derived from Fe-Co-Ni.
Claims stacking-fault energy is the property targeted for improvement, whereas the target is magnetic coercivity, specifically exceeding the approximately 100 Oe single-phase-fcc limit.
Substitutes spin magnetic moments and longitudinal spin fluctuations for the explicitly requested orbital-moment contribution.
Omits the fcc/C14 Laves dual-phase microstructure, phase-specific magnetic transitions, antiferromagnetic Ti-sublattice coupling, and domain-wall pinning mechanism.
Predicts temperature-dependent stacking-fault behavior rather than the observed coercive field of approximately 667 Oe at 400 K and multiple magnetic transitions.
